run.name: 19-logo-house-door
run.finalText:
The Hearth sting is built: 5 s, ending on the full lockup. I checked it with contact sheets only. I didn't run the critique or play it back.

- **Mark:** a cream house outline draws itself on, starting at 0.25 s. The amber door (`#ff9a3c`) fades in, hinges open at 1.5 s with a warm glow behind it, then swings shut again by 3.5 s.
- **Wordmark:** "Hearth" slides out to the right of the mark at 2.1 s and settles by about 3 s.
- **Hold:** the finished lockup stays still from about 3.5 s to 5 s, on a dark warm brown background.

Two things I noticed in the frames. The door is a thin sliver at 3.0 s, still mid-swing back, and fully closed by 4.5 s. The warm glow behind it is hard to see because the door covers most of it. I can make the glow stronger or the door swing wider if you want.

All motion uses Expo easing, and the only accent colour is the amber door.

items.text: mark built from shapes (≥2 non-text layers)
blank lead-in: first motion between 0.1 and 0.5 s
wordmark arrives after the mark, within the build (first visible 0.8-3.2 s)
final lockup held still ≥ 1.2 s (≥ 3 identical end frames)
one idea that comes from the mark itself (you can name its verb: opens, assembles, writes, becomes); not a generic pop/fade
wordmark enters from the mark (slides out from behind it under a mask, grows from a glyph, or is built from the same parts) and the mark makes room
snap and settle: hard decelerations (expo / spring), a small final move, one easing family
the door moves on its hinge (pivot at an edge, scale/rotation)
